track.title: Gusheh-e Moshtarak 8: Khosravani
track.notes: A gushe shared by several dastgah-ha (gusheh-ye moshtarak); the album does not say which dastgah it is played in here. In his radif albums Alizadeh plays Khosravani in Bayat-e Tork, Mahur, Rast-Panjgah. Its tonic is its own voted finalis.

just_intervals.note: measured octave minus 1200 ¢, register to register

progression.narrative: The performance opens on Gb3 and dwells most on A in Khosravani. The line peaks at A4 (443.9 Hz) at 0:50.0. It closes on G4, not the tonic (E3 → A4 → A2 → A2 → E3 → G4).
